name_input: 1 UNIT- JAYASHREE TEXTILES 2.UNIT- GRASIM PREMIUM FABRIC
court_cases: Indian Kanoon returns 4,434 documents mentioning Grasim Industries Ltd (checked 23.11.2026). The visible top-10 are predominantly tax/customs/excise and civil matters where the company appears as appellant/petitioner, e.g. M/s Grasim Industries Ltd vs Collector of Customs, Bombay (SC, 04.04.2002); Grasim Industries Ltd vs Union of India (SC, 13.10.2011); Grasim Industries Ltd vs State of Kerala (SC, 19.04.2017); Grasim Industries Ltd vs Premchand (MP HC, 09.10.2017); The Management of M/s Grasim Industries vs The General Secretary (Karnataka HC, 05.07.2022, industrial dispute). No criminal case, insolvency or winding-up proceeding identified in the reviewed sample. Full docket-level party role/status for all 4,434 hits not verified - null for the remainder.
news_risk: No negative news or regulator action confirmed. Note: web_search backend was unavailable (searx connection refused) during this check, so open-web news and regulator databases (SEBI, NCLT, IBBI) could not be queried - this is an absence of verification, not a verified clean record. Grasim's own credit-rating page (grasim.com/investors/credit-rating) loaded only its navigation index; the underlying rating documents returned empty bodies, so no rating agency, rating level or date could be read. CRISIL rating-list search returned a 404.
note: Sanctions: OFAC Sanctions List Search page was reachable (SDN list last updated 23.11.2026) but its lookup is JavaScript-driven and returned no query results via plain fetch; UN/EU/UK consolidated lists and the BIS Entity List were not queried because the search backend failed. Therefore sanctions_hit is null = NOT VERIFIED, not a confirmed negative. No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS was found: an Indian Kanoon query for 'Grasim Industries Russia' returned only 2 unrelated hits (a 2022 Karnataka HC industrial-dispute matter and a 2008 excise tribunal order), and no customs/export record naming Russia was located. rf_supply null = not public / not found, not a denial. Credit rating null: not publicly retrievable in this session (see news_risk). Per project rules, court and regulatory matters are not rejection grounds; nothing here indicates liquidation, bankruptcy or non-existence. Recommended follow-up: re-run sanctions screening against OFAC/EU/UK/BIS lists and pull the CRISIL/ICRA/India Ratings press releases directly once search access is restored.
